title: Lightweight Low-Frequency Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring via Karhunen-Lo\`eve Feature Distillation and Temporal Convolutional Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) is a critical enabler for demand-side management which allows for smart grid optimization. A deployment-ready NILM solution necessitates three key features: accurate disaggregation, low-frequency sampling, and low computational cost. This paper proposes a lightweight, edge-oriented NILM framework that combines activity-boundary-aware synthetic data augmentation with Karhunen-Lo\`eve Transform (KLT) feature extraction and a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). The augmentation stage extracts and recombines complete or near-complete appliance activation segments so that the model can be trained without new fully labeled household aggregates. The KLT filter bank extracts decorrelated, appliance-informed temporal features which are then fed into a compact TCN along with the original aggregate for energy disaggregation. translated_title: 基于Karhunen-Loève特征蒸馏与时序卷积网络的轻量级低频非侵入式负荷监测
translated_abstract: 非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）是实现需求侧管理、支持智能电网优化的关键使能技术。一个可实际部署的NILM解决方案需要具备三个关键特性：准确的负荷分解、低频采样和低计算成本。本文提出了一种轻量级、面向边缘设备的NILM框架，该框架将活动边界感知的合成数据增强与Karhunen-Loève变换（KLT）特征提取以及时序卷积网络（TCN）相结合。数据增强阶段通过提取并重新组合完整或接近完整的电器运行片段，使模型无需新的完整标注的家庭总负荷数据即可完成训练。KLT滤波器组提取去相关的、电器感知的时序特征，随后将这些特征与原始总负荷数据一同输入紧凑的TCN进行能量分解。在两个标准NILM数据集UK-DALE和REDD上以10秒采样进行的评估表明……
tldr: 提出了一种面向边缘设备的轻量级NILM框架，通过活动边界感知的数据增强、KLT特征提取和紧凑型TCN，在低频采样下以低计算成本实现准确的负荷分解。
en_tdlr: Proposes a lightweight edge-oriented NILM framework that combines activity-boundary-aware synthetic data augmentation, Karhunen-Loève Transform feature extraction, and a compact TCN to achieve accurate load disaggregation at low-frequency sampling with low computational cost.
